whyDuo.text:
iPhone Duo

• Cover, and open in landscape: status bar, Back/Close, toolbar and tab bar sit on the trailing edge (DuoSideBar)
• Open in landscape: list and detail side by side, split at the fold; sheets become inspectors beside the content
• Open in portrait: laid out like an iPad mini. Standard horizontal bars (DuoTopBar, tab bar at the bottom), one full-height view that pushes to detail, filters as a form sheet; only Settings keeps its list beside the detail
• Book pose: nothing crosses the fold; the reader shows one page per pane
• Reader: immersive mode hides every control and the status bar; a tap brings them back

whyIphone.text:
What changes on every iPhone

• Floating glass tab bar; Search gets its own button (Tab role .search)
• Large titles and grouped sections in system type and spacing
• Glass toolbar groups on Work Detail and the Reader
• Read Aloud lives in a bottom accessory, like Music's mini player
• The four symbols (Rating, Category, Warnings, Status) on every work, same order everywhere
• Density kept: words, chapters, kudos and hits stay visible
